claire: Apply in staging failed. Plan wants to replace a k8s Secret and the apply is stuck on a remote state lock. Anyone seen this combo?
jonathan: Can you paste the plan snippet so we can see why it's replacing?
claire: ```
-/+ kubernetes_secret.service_api (new resource required)
  ~ data["env"] = "redacted" -> (known after apply)
  ~ metadata.annotations["checksum/config"] = "abc123" -> "def456"

Plan: 1 to add, 1 to change, 1 to destroy.
```
ashok: Looks like a checksum/annotation changed from re-encryption. Did we rotate the KMS key or reencrypt the YAML?
claire: yep rotated the KMS key last night. CI ran and now terraform wants to replace the Secret. Also seeing remote lock id: lock-0a1b2c3d.
devops-bot: CI pipeline #3422 (runner ci-runner) is currently holding a Terraform lock. Auto-unlock scheduled in ~10m unless the job finishes.
jonathan: If the runner is hung, prefer canceling the pipeline and then manually unlocking rather than force-unlock immediately. If it's clear, you can `terraform force-unlock lock-0a1b2c3d` from ops account.
ashok: After unlock, two safe approaches: 1) import the existing k8s secret into state to match live resource: `terraform import module.k8s.kubernetes_secret.service_api default/svc-api-secret` 2) or if you want TF to stop managing it temporarily: `kubectl apply -f secret.yaml` then `terraform state rm module.k8s.kubernetes_secret.service_api` and reconcile later.
claire: I'm going to cancel the pipeline now. Can someone with ops creds be ready to unlock?
jonathan: I can do it in 5m. When you cancel, post the lock id again.
claire: canceled. lock id is lock-0a1b2c3d.
jonathan: running: `terraform force-unlock lock-0a1b2c3d` (ops). Unlock succeeded.
ashok: Next: run `terraform state show module.k8s.kubernetes_secret.service_api` to inspect, then `terraform import` if the id differs. Also check the manifest generator — it may annotate with a checksum of the encrypted blob, which changed after re-encrypt.
claire: import done: `terraform import module.k8s.kubernetes_secret.service_api default/svc-api-secret`
jonathan: Nice. Now run a targeted plan: `terraform plan -target=module.k8s.kubernetes_secret.service_api` and confirm it no longer wants replace.
claire: running now... plan looks clean, no replace. I'll run apply during the maintenance window.
ashok: One more note: if this recurs after key rotation, consider pinning the checksum annotation to a stable field or make the annotation content deterministic across re-encrypts. Otherwise the plan will keep wanting to replace.
claire: good call — opening a small follow-up PR to change how the checksum annotation is generated.
devops-bot: Reminder: prefer cancel + unlock vs immediate force-unlock when CI owns the lock. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tf-locks
claire: thanks all, will update when apply completes. :thumbsup:
